case_title.quote: RAM AUTAR & ORS. v. STATE OF U.P.
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.correct_value: Four named accused (Deo Munni, Ram Autar, Suraj Bali, Chandra Bali); total number not explicitly stated
number_of_accused.quote: the appellants along with Suraj Bali and Chandra Bali pounced on the deceased
number_of_accused.reason: Four accused are named, but the judgment never states a total count.

accused_gender.quote: appellant Deo Munni @ Putti, at his instance, brought his gun
accused_gender.reason: Male pronouns are used for the accused.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of accused is not mentioned.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of accused is not mentioned.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation of accused is not mentioned.

previous_criminal_record.quote: the accused- appellants do not have any infamous criminal background as well
previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment states the appellants have no infamous criminal background, not that it is unstated.

victim_gender.quote: the deceased herded back the cattle and returned home crestfallen
victim_gender.reason: Deceased referred to with male pronouns; male victim.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused- appellants, first informant as well as the deceased did descend from a common ancestor
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused and deceased are relatives descended from a common ancestor.

offence_category.correct_value: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder (s.304 Part I) after trial charge under s.302
offence_category.quote: conviction of the appellants under Section 304-Part I read with Sections 147, 148, 149 IPC
offence_category.reason: Final conviction is under s.304 Part I, not murder; the murder charge was altered.

statutory_provisions.quote: conviction of the appellants under Section 304-Part I read with Sections 147, 148, 149 IPC
statutory_provisions.reason: Matches final provisions; original s.302 charge omitted but not required.

weapon.quote: the other accused persons joined in the assaults with lath is
weapon.reason: Lathis were also used in the assault alongside the gun.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness, medical, sketch map and blood-stained earth collection with chemical analyst report
evidence_type.quote: the blood stained earth collected therefrom in course of the investigation
evidence_type.reason: 'Recovery' is not described; blood-stained earth collection and chemical report are the relevant items.

confession.reason: No confession is mentioned in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Spur of the moment incident without premeditation; no infamous criminal background; over three decades since incident; deceased contributed to tension
mitigating_circumstances.quote: The incident happened on the spur of the moment and in an uncontrollable, embittered and agitated state of enragement
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment clearly identifies several mitigating circumstances, so 'None noted' is wrong.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: Convicted under Sections 302, 147, 148 and 149 IPC; life imprisonment for s.302
trial_court_outcome.quote: convicted all the accused persons under Sections 302, 147,148 B and 149 !PC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under s.302 is right but omits the 147-149 convictions and life sentence.

high_court_outcome.quote: moderated the conviction under Section 302 IPC to one under Section 304-Part I
high_court_outcome.reason: Matches the High Court modification described.

final_outcome.quote: The appeal is thus partly allowed with the above modifications.
final_outcome.reason: Conviction maintained under modified provisions; 'convicted' is supported.

offence_finally_established.quote: conviction of the appellants under Section 304-Part I read with Sections 147, 148, 149 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Final offence is the s.304 Part I offence, which matches this label.

imprisonment_type.quote: the sentence for the offence under Section 304-Part I/149 IPC to rigorous imprisonment for 7 years
imprisonment_type.reason: Rigorous imprisonment for a fixed term is stated.

imprisonment_years.quote: reduce the sentence for the offence under Section 304-Part 1/149 IPC to rigorous imprisonment for 7 years
imprisonment_years.reason: Seven years matches the reduced sentence.

fine_rs.quote: fine of Rs.5000/-, in default, simple imprisonment for further two months
fine_rs.reason: High Court imposed Rs.5000 fine; null ignores this, though SC did not restate it.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Facts without stating the outcome; no HC finding on premeditation or criminal background
neutral_facts.quote: there was as such no pre-meditation or prior concert on the part of the accused persons to commit murder
neutral_facts.reason: Summary reveals the outcome and wrongly attributes the no-premeditation finding to the High Court rather than the Supreme Court.

offence_severity.quote: reduced to rigorous imprisonment for 7 years
offence_severity.reason: Matches the final sentence stated in the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Victim died, so the offence is completed.

physical_harm.quote: fire arm wounds on the head, chest and right upper arm of the deceased
physical_harm.reason: Injuries and cause of death match the medical evidence.

number_of_offences.quote: charge was framed under Section 302, read with Sections 147/ 149 IPC
number_of_offences.reason: Charged and upheld offences match the judgment.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Arhar crop allegedly destroyed by the deceased's cattle (prior incident)
financial_property_loss.quote: had allegedly destroyed the Arhar crop of the accused persons
financial_property_loss.reason: Crop destruction is alleged background loss, so 'Not applicable' overlooks it.

premeditation_planning.quote: there was as such no pre-meditation or prior concert on the part of the accused persons
premeditation_planning.reason: Matches the judgment's finding on premeditation and spur of the moment.

motive.correct_value: Dispute over deceased's cattle straying into accused's fields and destroying crop, leading to abuse and altercation
motive.quote: the cattle of the deceased had strayed into the fields ofSuraj Bali and others and had allegedly destroyed the Arhar crop
motive.reason: Judgment identifies the cattle trespass and crop dispute as the source of the quarrel.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: they have with noteworthy consistency and cohesion authenticated the case of the prosecution
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the eyewitness and post-mortem evidence the court accepted.

witness_credibility.quote: they have with noteworthy consistency and cohesion authenticated the case of the prosecution in all material particulars
witness_credibility.reason: Matches the court's assessment of eyewitness reliability.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct is discussed in the judgment.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date matches; trial and appeal dates are not stated.

legal_representation.quote: Dr. J. P. Dhanda, Ms. Raj Rani Dhanda, Vineet Dhanda, N. A. Usmani, Mohd. Shahid Hussain, Advs. for the Appellant.
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names for appellants and State match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: After the charge-sheet was laid against the accused persons, charge was framed
investigation_status.reason: FIR, charge-sheet and completed trial match the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity is noted in the judgment.

appeal_history.quote: the High Court in appeal sustained the conviction under Sections 147/148/149 IPC but moderated the conviction under Section 302
appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes match the judgment.

prosecution_argument.quote: had formed an unlawful assembly and had with the intention of eliminating the deceased, had jointly launched a lethal attack
prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the prosecution's submissions on unlawful assembly and lethal attack.

defence_argument.correct_value: Deceased and cohorts attacked accused; DW-1 Shyam Lal fired in self-defence; no pre-meditation or pre-concert
defence_argument.quote: for which DW-1 Shyam Lal had to open fire in self defence
defence_argument.reason: Defence said Shyam Lal fired in self-defence, not that the accused used a firearm.

legal_principle_applied.quote: there was as such no pre-meditation or prior concert on the part of the accused persons to commit murder
legal_principle_applied.reason: Fair paraphrase of the no-common-object reasoning and sentence reduction.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: No precedent is cited in the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: The evidence demonstrates that the accused- appellants do not have any infamous criminal background
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Listed mitigating factors match the judgment's reasoning.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are identified in the judgment.

other_sentence_order.quote: The other sentences are hereby affirmed.
other_sentence_order.reason: Matches the order reducing one sentence and affirming the rest.
